subject: Lyra Health — MAP and proposed go-live runway
messages:
From: Samira Ali <samira@lyrahealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lyra MAP & go-live runway

Hi Irene —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Tom and I reviewed the notes and we need a simple mutual action plan that lines up milestones, owners and dates so we can present to our IT and procurement leads by next Wednesday. High-level asks from our side:

- Security/compliance sign-off (SOC2 evidence) — target slot during week of 6/7
- Data ingestion & mapping (staging) — 2-week window prior to UAT
- UAT with our product team — ideally mid-June
- Production cutover — end of June if feasible

Can you send a one-sheet MAP with owners and clear go/no-go gates? Also attach any standard onboarding checklist you use for enterprise customers.

Attached: SOC2 questionnaire (for your team to review).

Best,
Samira
Head of Integrations, Lyra Health
From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Ali <samira@lyrahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lyra MAP & go-live runway

Samira —

Thanks — draft MAP attached (lyra_map_draft.xlsx). I pulled together a pragmatic 7-week runway that matches the slots you suggested. Key highlights:

- Week of 5/17: Kickoff + account onboarding (Redwood: Irene; Lyra: Tom)
- 5/24–6/4: Data ingestion & staging (Redwood: Marissa; Lyra: Data Eng lead)
- 6/7–6/11: Compliance review & SOC2 evidence exchange (Redwood: Jordan)
- 6/14–6/18: UAT (product + ops) — acceptance criteria in Sheet 2
- 6/28: Target production cutover (go/no-go on 6/21)

Please review owners and dates in the attached. Marissa will be the implementation lead once we move past kickoff; Jordan will own the compliance exchange and evidence readiness. If you need the UAT window earlier/later we can adjust — the main constraint is giving your data team a 2-week staging window.

Next steps: confirm owners, and we’ll lock a 60-minute kickoff for the week of 5/17.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Samira Ali <samira@lyrahealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@lyrahealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lyra MAP & go-live runway

Irene —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few requests from our side after a quick sync with Tom and security:

- Can we move the compliance review to week of 6/14? Our security team has a backlog and prefers to pair with your team during the UAT week to reduce context switching.
- UAT: can we extend to 6/14–6/25 (two weeks) — that gives our clinical QA team more runway to validate edge cases.
- Can Marissa please share a short list of prerequisite access items for our Data Eng team (S3 role, sample records, retention notes)?

I attached the SOC2 questionnaire we sent earlier — let me know if anything is missing on your end. If the revised windows look okay, we can confirm a kickoff on 5/19 at 10am PT.

Best,
Samira
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Ali <samira@lyrahealth.com>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lyra MAP & go-live runway — updated MAP and access checklist

Samira / team —

Thanks for the notes. I updated the MAP (file: redwood_map_v2.xlsx) to reflect:

- Compliance paired review during UAT (6/14–6/25) — Jordan will coordinate with your security lead to consume SOC2 items and log evidence transfer dates.
- UAT extended to two weeks with explicit acceptance criteria per sprint day.
- Added an Access & Onboarding checklist (Sheet 3) with S3 role names, sample file spec, and data retention expectations.

I included a short prereq list below for Data Eng to action before staging:
- Create a Redwood ingestion role (ARN) with read access to the sample S3 prefix (we need a CSV sample with 500 rows)
- Share a sample dataset (anonymized) and schema by 5/21
- Confirm retention policy and any PII masking expectations

If this all looks good, we’ll schedule kickoff 5/19 10:00 PT and follow with a weekly 30-minute ops sync after kickoff (Wednesdays).

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Samira Ali <samira@lyrahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lyra MAP & go-live runway — updated MAP and access checklist

Marissa / Irene / Jordan —

This reads well — thanks for folding our ask into the timeline.

Confirming: kickoff 5/19 10:00 PT, weekly ops sync Wednesdays 30m, UAT 6/14–6/25 (Jordan to coordinate SOC2 evidence during that window), target production cutover 6/28 with go/no-go on 6/21.

We’ll share the sample dataset and create the ingestion role by 5/21. Once kickoff is scheduled, I’ll invite our Data Eng and Security leads to the ops sync.

Samira
Head of Integrations, Lyra Health

--
Attachments referenced: lyra_soc2_questionnaire.pdf
